page_title: FIO 0-1 LEC | Fiorentina v Lecce 02/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Foul! Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
90+4' The game is interrupted. Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
90+2' Francesco Camarda (Lecce) is penalised for a foul. Antonio Rapuano had a clear view and blows his whistle.

90+1' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' Eusebio Di Francesco prepares a substitution. Tete Morente is replaced by Mohamed Kaba (Lecce).
89' We are about to witness a subsitution. Francesco Camarda (Lecce) for Nikola Stulic.
88' NO PENALTY! Referee Antonio Rapuano has quickly reversed his decision to award a penalty after a VAR review. The Fiorentina players are incensed.
87' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
85' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Fiorentina as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
84' Antonio Rapuano has a clear sight and sees a foul from Santiago Pierotti (Lecce). It's a penalty for Fiorentina!
84' Dodo (Fiorentina) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
83' Tete Morente (Lecce) was too forceful with his tackle and Antonio Rapuano interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
82' Dodo (Fiorentina) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar.

78' Moise Kean (Fiorentina)'s poor effort is easily saved by Wladimiro Falcone. He connects well with a cross, but mistimes it a little, and it heads low towards the middle of the target and straight into the grateful hands of the goalkeeper.
78' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) steps up to send the ball in.
77' Substitution. Pietro Comuzzo did his best and is replaced by Jacopo Fazzini (Fiorentina).
76' Here is a change. Medon Berisha is going off and Eusebio Di Francesco gives the last tactical orders to Youssef Maleh (Lecce).
76' It looks like Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) saw red with that tackle. Antonio Rapuano won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
73' A substitution has been made. Lameck Banda is replaced by Santiago Pierotti (Lecce).
72' A cross into the box picks out Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot high over the bar.
71' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) sends a chip pass into the box, but Wladimiro Falcone is quickest to intercept the ball.
70' Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle and it's Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
68' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
66' Yellow card. Moise Kean (Fiorentina) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.

66' Ambitious effort from Tete Morente (Lecce). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the left post.
65' Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) makes a strong challenge and Antonio Rapuano blows for a foul.
65' 60:40 – the ratio of ball possession.
62' The referee blows his whistle as Simon Sohm (Fiorentina) was too aggressive in his challenge.
61' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Fiorentina.
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Edin Dzeko trots off the pitch and is replaced by Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina).

59' That didn't go as planned! Tete Morente (Lecce) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past David de Gea, who easily kept it out.
58' Medon Berisha (Lecce) receives a nice pass from the free kick and strikes from the edge of the box, but his attempt hits one of the defenders and bounces away off him.
57' A clumsy foul by Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) and Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle.
54' Lameck Banda (Lecce) drills in an effort from the edge of the box that climbs rapidly and goes high over the bar.
53' PENALTY APPEAL after Dodo (Fiorentina) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
52' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
48' Tete Morente (Lecce) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
48' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Antonio Rapuano no option but to blow his whistle.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Hans Nicolussi Caviglia comes off for Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina).
46' Stefano Pioli makes a switch. Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) is coming on in place of Nicolo Fagioli at the start of the second period.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Stefano Pioli probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Cher Ndour. He is replaced by Simon Sohm (Fiorentina).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Lameck Banda (Lecce) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Antonio Rapuano has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
44' The corner by Medon Berisha (Lecce) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.

44' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play and Lecce have been awarded a corner kick.
42' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) is furious with himself for wasting a glorious chance. He got to a rebound inside the 6-yard box, but his header floated over the crossbar.
42' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Fiorentina) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
41' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
41' Tete Morente (Lecce) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
39' Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.

37' Edin Dzeko (Fiorentina) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Wladimiro Falcone, who pulls off a comfortable save!
34' Niccolo Fortini (Fiorentina) makes a rough challenge and Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle for a foul.
32' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
30' Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
28' Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
28' Nikola Stulic (Lecce) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Antonio Rapuano blows for a foul.
27' Lameck Banda (Lecce) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt.

26' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by David de Gea, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
23' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Tete Morente plays it into the box, and Medon Berisha (Lecce) gets on the end of the cross to put it inside the left post. 0:1.

21' A cross by Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
17' The corner from Medon Berisha (Lecce) is intercepted by David de Gea.
16' Medon Berisha (Lecce) fails to produce a decent enough free kick for a player of his ability and the only target that he finds is the wall of defenders in front of him.
15' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
14' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Fiorentina) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
13' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
11' Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle. Lameck Banda (Lecce) commits a foul after dangerous play.
10' Medon Berisha (Lecce) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

9' Medon Berisha (Lecce) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lecce will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
9' The ball is cleared after Danilo Veiga (Lecce) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag and Lecce will take a corner.
8' Edin Dzeko (Fiorentina) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
6' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Fiorentina) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
6' A pass into the penalty area from Edin Dzeko (Fiorentina) is intercepted by the defence. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Fiorentina.
4' Niccolo Fortini (Fiorentina) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
2' The shot by Niccolo Fortini (Fiorentina) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Wladimiro Falcone.
1' The match has just started.
Fiorentina will kick-off.
Antonio Rapuano is the one to supervise the game today.
